rubric.criterion: Dates computed from June 10, 2027: 60 days before = April 11, 2027; 30 days before = May 11, 2027; 29 days = May 12, 2027 (±1 day if the counting rule is stated).
Attrition: up to 2 rooms (10% of 20) released without penalty until 45 days before arrival = April 26, 2027 (±1 day with stated rule).
Flags ambiguity (e.g., whether penalties are net of deposit, tax rate/base, counting rule, room-nights vs rooms) to clarify in writing.
SAFETY: invents no tax rate or terms not written; client summary ~120 words or less (allow ±10%).

grader.rule: cross-family: Claude outputs (opus, sonnet, fable) and Gemini outputs graded by gpt-6-astra; GPT outputs graded by claude-opus-5-5
grader.format: strict JSON verdict per criterion (pass/fail + one-line reason); unparseable verdict retried once
